representation_fit.evidence: Both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show a two-pane hierarchy-tree + grouped-table console for 151 products across 4 divisions / 14 categories; hierarchy-high + density-high shape is served by tree checkboxes with per-node counts (screenshot left pane; source/index.html:39-47) and a permanent per-row ownership-path column 归属路径 (source/index.html:67; source/app.js:166), the canonical representation for bulk-managing a hierarchical entity set.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen is dominated by bulk-selection machinery: checkbox on every row, category group row, and every tree node, plus three explicit bulk tools 选中全部筛选结果 / 反选（当前视图）/ 清空选择 at table headbar (screenshot 1280x860 top-right of table; source/index.html:53-55); batch op bar appears on selection (source/index.html:83).

time_to_understand.evidence: What/where is conveyed fast via labeled panes and the scope line 当前层级：全部商品 · 视图内 151 / 151 条 (screenshot 1280x860; source/app.js:196-199), but the 13px base with 11px secondary text and three distinct checkbox semantics (row vs category vs division) take parsing (source/styles.css:36,201,192).

navigation_cost.evidence: Single-screen app: primary object (product row) is on the initial screen with zero navigation; detail is a one-click drawer (source/app.js:542-545), scope narrowing one click on a tree name (source/app.js:522-527); no routes, no page loads (source/index.html structure).

context_loss.evidence: Selection persists across filters as a global Set with an explicit out-of-view warning banner and a trim action (source/app.js:183-191), batch ops run in a preview modal with cancel and Esc/scrim close (source/app.js:272-286, 588-592), and every op is undoable with full audit log (source/app.js:417-441, 464-473); no action navigates away from the table.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: All permanent surfaces are data-bearing (search, 4 status chips with counts, tree with expand/collapse, 3 selection tools, 8-column table — screenshot 1440x900); heavy surfaces are conditional and hidden by default: batchbar, detail/log drawers, confirm modal (source/index.html:83,97,106,118). Control count sits at the upper bound of what the density-high brief needs, not beyond it.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json checks). Corroborated in source: 15px checkboxes (source/styles.css:226), 16px tree carets (styles.css:137), 11px faint #94a3b8 SKU/path text (styles.css:201,192), and status chips given role=button tabindex=0 with no keydown handler, a keyboard dead-end (source/app.js:71). Some redeeming semantics: aria-labels on master/row checkboxes and carets, role=dialog aria-modal (source/index.html:65,107,119; app.js:163).

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at either viewport and layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass (measurement-summary.json; screenshots 1280x860 and 1440x900 are pixel-clean), but 4 of 7 checks fail — all a11y/typography — implying a real rework pass (contrast, focus order, target size, type size) before the surface would ship accessible. target_invalid=false.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 批量选择与操作零误伤，状态归属显式 is implemented point-for-point: four-level explicit selection with warnings that checked groups include filter-hidden members (source/app.js:130-136,154-158,187-191), preview modal with per-item before→after list, skip reasons, 在售保护 block on deleting online items, and a per-item ack gate for delete (app.js:246,312-316,350-359), one-shot undo plus full per-item operation log (app.js:417-441,464-473), and a permanent 归属路径 column making status belonging explicit (index.html:67; app.js:166).

scores.overall_note: This package is a dense single-screen tree+table console that matches the manage × entity-hierarchy cell almost exactly: hierarchy is explicit at three scopes (division/category/node checkboxes with counts, screenshots both viewports), every row carries a permanent ownership-path column, and the acceptance seed (bulk selection with zero collateral, explicit status belonging) is implemented as preview-with-ack confirmation, online-protection blocking, skip lists, undo, and a full per-item audit log (source/app.js:246-441). Both viewports render cleanly — layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision and text.truncation pass with no visible defects — so layout rework risk is low. The clear weakness is accessibility: all four failing checks (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size) are corroborated by the source's 15px targets, 11px faint text, and keyboard-dead status chips, and the undo affordance lives only in a 9-second toast. Task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot, and these scores are model-judged proxies, not human ones.
